---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible behavior problem without private environment data.
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

Describe the expected behavior, actual behavior, and smallest reproduction.

Include the package version or commit, Node version, transport/profile, and
whether the result came from fixtures, a container, or a live deployment.
Use only synthetic examples and sanitized error codes.

Do not include credentials, JWTs, tenant/account identifiers, live datasets,
raw QIX/browser payloads, or local environment files. Report security issues
privately as described in SECURITY.md.
